instruction:
Fix `packages/excalidraw/tests/pages.test.tsx` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. Gate 3 revise from the user: add three new tests to this file, inside its existing describe, leaving every existing test unchanged.
(a) AC-2 renderable elements: `import * as StaticScene from "../renderer/staticScene";` and `const renderStaticScene = vi.spyOn(StaticScene, "renderStaticScene");` (the pattern contextmenu.test.tsx:10 and :49 use). Create one element on page A and one on page B, switch to page B, wait for a render, then read `renderStaticScene.mock.lastCall![0]` and assert its `visibleElements` ids and the keys of its `elementsMap` (StaticSceneRenderConfig in packages/excalidraw/scene/types.ts lines ~111-144) contain page B's element id and not page A's.
(b) AC-2 hit-testing: with a page-A element at known coordinates, switch to page B, then `mouse.click` on the centre of where the page-A element sits (Pointer/mouse helpers from ./helpers/ui as the file already uses), and assert `Object.keys(h.state.selectedElementIds)` is empty.
(c) AC-7 reorder round trip: create two more pages so there are three, reorder them with `h.app.actionManager.executeAction(actionReorderPages, "ui", { fromIndex, toIndex })` (actionPages.tsx line 159), place an element on each page, then `serializeAsJSON(h.scene.getAllElementsIncludingDeleted(), h.state, h.app.files, "local")`, `JSON.parse`, and `restore(parsed, null, null)`. Assert `restored.appState.pages.map(p => p.id)` equals the reordered order, and for every element `getElementPageId(restored el)` equals `getElementPageId(original el)`.
These are new tests only: no toMatchSnapshot, and no change to existing snapshot or render-count assertions.
